description:
This is the standard build order for Ayyubid FC. It works vs. every civ but not against Delhi & English (at the high level). Against these civs, you want to switch style. 

Video Linked below
name: Fast Castle Ayyubids Guide
author: Valdemar1902

notes: 6 @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ to @resource/berrybush.png@, 2@unit_worker/villager-abbasid.png@ build @building_economy/mill.png@
New @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ builds @building_economy/house.png@ to connect @building_economy/mill.png@ with @building_economy/town-center.png@ then goes to @resource/berrybush.png@

Add 4 New @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.png@. 1st @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.png@ builds @building_economy/mining-camp.png@, 2nd @landmark_abbasid/house-of-wisdom.png@ close to the @resource/resource_gold.png@
1 New @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ to @resource/sheep.png@
@age/age_2.webp@@technology_ayyubids/military-wing-reinforcement-1.png@ (use DRs to raid and/or counter cavalry units + buy you time to go age 3)

Take 4 @resource/resource_food.webp@ @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.png@ + 1@unit_worker/villager-abbasid.png@ from@building_economy/town-center.png@ & send to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@. Gather 150 @resource/resource_wood.png@ then go gather 50 @resource/resource_stone.png@ (no mining camp)
Keep @resource/rally.png@@building_economy/town-center.png@ on @resource/resource_food.png@
1 @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@@resource/resource_gold.png@ build @building_defensive/outpost.png@ (upgrade when 50 @resource/resource_stone.png@)
@building_economy/house.webp@
5 @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@@resource/resource_stone.png@ go to @resource/resource_food.png@
<--- Remacro and @resource/rally.webp@to @resource/resource_food.png@ until age 3
Drop off res and go @age/age_3.webp@ @technology_ayyubids/economic-wing-growth-1.png@
<--- Remacro. @building_economy/town-center.webp@@resource/rally.png@ new @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.png@ to @resource/resource_gold.png@ until 12
@technology_economy/double-broadaxe.webp@@technology_economy/wheelbarrow.png@
@building_military/stable.webp@@building_economy/house.png@
@technology_ayyubids/economic-wing-growth-1.webp@ go to @resource/resource_food.png@
Construct @building_religious/mosque.png@ and grab as many @resource/relics.png@ as possible (3 @unit_ayyubids/dervish-3.png@)
@technology_economy/horticulture.png@ (when possible)
2nd @building_military/stable.webp@

@building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ (get @technology_military/iron-undermesh.png@@technology_military/wedge-rivets.png@->@technology_military/steeled-arrow.png@@technology_military/balanced-projectiles.png@ -> (sultans mamluks)

build 3 @building_military/archery-range.webp@@building_military/archery-range.png@@building_military/archery-range.png@ and have 15@unit_worker/villager-abbasid.png@ on @resource/resource_wood.png@ (5 per range)
more info:

Keep adding more and more production as you start floating. You have to CONSTANTLY produce @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@and @unit_ayyubids/camel-lancer-3.png@. Look for fights and when you push your opponent, make 2-4 @unit_ayyubids/manjaniq-3.png@and go for the slow kill with fire attack to force your opponent out of their base.

Upgrades (@technology_military/balanced-projectiles.png@+@technology_military/wedge-rivets.png@) are incredibly important and if you have fully upgraded archers, they last you very long and you forego the need for early expensive xbows. Don't be afraid to add a 2nd @building_technology/blacksmith.png@if necessary. The @unit_ayyubids/camel-lancer-3.png@+ @unit_infantry/archer-2.png@comp is goated.
Eco upgrades are also important. Get them as you can fit them in, but dont prioritise them over @building_technology/blacksmith.png@upgrades and @unit_ayyubids/dervish-3.png@.
6 @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ to @resource/berrybush.png@, 2@unit_worker/villager-abbasid.png@ build @building_economy/mill.png@
New @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ builds @building_economy/house.png@ to connect @building_economy/mill.png@ with @building_economy/town-center.png@ then goes to @resource/berrybush.png@

Add 4 New @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.png@. 1st @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.png@ builds @building_economy/mining-camp.png@, 2nd @landmark_abbasid/house-of-wisdom.png@ close to the @resource/resource_gold.png@
1 New @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ to @resource/sheep.png@
@technology_ayyubids/economic-wing-growth-1.webp@@landmark_abbasid/culture-wing.png@

Take 3 @resource/resource_gold.webp@ @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.png@ and send to @resource/resource_stone.png@. Leave 4 @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.png@ on @resource/berrybush.png@ & rest go to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@
@building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ on @resource/resource_stone.png@
@building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@ with all 8@resource/resource_wood.png@@unit_worker/villager-abbasid.png@.
Build @building_economy/house.png@
@resource/rally.png@@resource/resource_food.png@ until 6@unit_worker/villager-abbasid.png@ then@resource/rally.png@ @resource/resource_wood.png@.
3 @technology_ayyubids/economic-wing-growth-1.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.png@ for Upgrades. Keep them there unless needed for production.
Build a @building_military/stable.webp@+ multiple @building_economy/house.png@ for @age/goldenagetier1.png@. Build Horsemen
Build 2nd @building_economy/town-center.webp@

description:
Fast Castle Build Order based on Beasty's March 7th, 2024 guide.

Focused on first build order covered in video (delayed production of military units). Be sure to watch video to see different adaptations based on your choices in House of Wisdom and opponent playstyles.

Tried to include more info than necessary to help new players to Ayyubid (myself).
name: 2024 Ayyubids Castle Rush [Beasty]
author: snoasis

notes: All 6 villagers @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ to berries @resource/berrybush.png@ (2 villagers @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.png@ build mill @building_economy/mill.png@)
*** Try to not completely exhaust berries. Future age-up will provide bonus to berry bushes that still remain
Send next villager @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ to berries @resource/berrybush.png@ (Build 1 @building_economy/house.png@ on the way)
Send next villager @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ to gold@resource/resource_gold.png@ (Build mine@building_economy/mining-camp.png@ on the way)
Rally next 3 villagers @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ to gold @resource/resource_gold.png@ (Build House of Wisdom @landmark_abbasid/house-of-wisdom.png@ on the way)

Rally villagers @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ to straggler trees @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@ until 4 vills on wood (Need wood for outposts @building_defensive/outpost.png@. Depending on Civ you're playing against, gather enough wood for 1-2 outposts)
@age/age_2.webp@ Age up to Feudal with appropriate Wing
- Reinforcements @technology_ayyubids/military-wing-reinforcement-1.png@: Good against horse Civs (MAKE SURE TO HAVE ENOUGH ROOM FOR NEW UNITS ON AGE UP)
- Master Smiths @technology_ayyubids/military-wing-master-smiths-1.png@: Good against archers Civs
- Growth @technology_ayyubids/economic-wing-growth-1.png@: Save for Castle age up (MAKE SURE TO HAVE ENOUGH ROOM FOR NEW UNITS ON AGE UP)
- Logistics @technology_ayyubids/culture-wing-logistics-1.png@: Save for Castle age up if against Civs that prioritize Relics, otherwise, save for Imperial age up
- Advancement @technology_ayyubids/culture-wing-advancement-1.png@: Save for later (when a quick age up can be decisive)

Send wood villagers @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager-abbasid.png@ to stone @resource/resource_stone.png@ (One trip provides enough stone (50) to upgrade 1 outpost @building_defensive/outpost.png@)
Rally @resource/rally.webp@ villagers @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.png@ to food @resource/resource_food.png@
*** Try to not completely exhaust berries. Future age-up will provide bonus to berry bushes that still remain
Send stone villagers @resource/resource_stone.webp@@unit_worker/villager-abbasid.png@ back to wood @resource/resource_wood.png@
Send Desert Raider @unit_ayyubids/desert-raider-2.webp@ from House of Wisdom @landmark_abbasid/house-of-wisdom.png@to harass (MAKE SURE TO HAVE ENOUGH ROOM FOR NEW UNITS ON AGE UP)
Rally villagers @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ to food @resource/resource_food.png@
*** Try to not completely exhaust berries. Future age-up will provide bonus to berry bushes that still remain
Send berry villagers @resource/berrybush.webp@@unit_worker/villager-abbasid.png@(should be around 7-8) to gold @resource/resource_gold.png@
@age/age_3.webp@ Age up to Castle with appropriate Wing

- Growth @technology_ayyubids/economic-wing-growth-1.png@: Get 8 villagers on age up, best in 90% of scenarios. Rally @resource/rally.png@ to berries @resource/berrybush.png@(MAKE SURE TO HAVE ENOUGH ROOM FOR NEW UNITS ON AGE UP)
- Logistics @technology_ayyubids/culture-wing-logistics-1.png@: Great if against Civs that prioritize Relics
- Advancement @technology_ayyubids/culture-wing-advancement-1.png@: Save for when a quick age up can be decisive
Rally villagers @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ to wood @resource/resource_wood.png@ until 12 (Build @building_economy/lumber-camp.png@ when necessary)
Get eco upgrades @technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@ + @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.png@ + @technology_economy/specialized-pick.png@
Rally villagers @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.png@ to food @resource/resource_food.png@ until 18
***MAKE SURE TO HAVE ENOUGH ROOM FOR NEW UNITS ON AGE UP***
Build Stables x2 @building_military/stable.webp@@building_military/stable.png@
Immediately queue Camel Lancers @unit_ayyubids/camel-lancer-3.webp@ and harass
Rally villagers @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ to wood@resource/resource_wood.png@
Build Mosque @building_religious/mosque.webp@ (consider building 2) and get relics @resource/relics.png@ (1 Relic = 2 Villagers on Gold)
***If opponent is massing units and playing aggressively, prioritize military production buildings
Build blacksmith @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ get appropriate upgrades (@technology_military/iron-undermesh.png@ + @technology_military/bloomery.png@ +  etc)
Upgrade to Veteran Camel Lancers @unit_ayyubids/camel-lancer-3.webp@ at stables @building_military/stable.png@
Rally villagers @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ to gold @resource/resource_gold.png@

Depending on how the game is being played at this point, prioritize military production @building_military/stable.webp@@building_military/archery-range.png@@building_military/barracks.png@ or build 2nd @building_economy/town-center.png@ or 3rd TC @building_economy/town-center.png@@building_economy/town-center.png@ to boom.

If opponent is attacking actively in Feudal with spearman @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ and archers @building_military/archery-range.png@, don't build Camel Lancers @unit_ayyubids/camel-lancer-3.png@.

Instead, build barracks @building_military/barracks.png@ and Ghulam @unit_abbasid/ghulam-3.png@ to break out. Add @building_military/archery-range.png@ @unit_infantry/archer-2.png@ @unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.png@ to support.
Camel Lancers @unit_ayyubids/camel-lancer-3.png@ in general are better because than Ghulam @unit_abbasid/ghulam-3.png@ because you can more easily harass and keep your opponent on defense.
Don't forget to build siege @building_military/siege-workshop.png@ units, specifically Manjaniq's @unit_ayyubids/manjaniq-3.png@
6 @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ to @resource/berrybush.webp@, 2@unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ build @building_economy/mill.webp@
New @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ builds @building_economy/house.webp@ to connect @building_economy/mill.webp@ with @building_economy/town-center.webp@ then goes to @resource/sheep.webp@

Add 4 New @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@. 1st @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ builds @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@, 2nd @landmark_abbasid/house-of-wisdom.webp@ close to the @resource/resource_gold.webp@
1 New @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ to @resource/sheep.webp@
@age/age_2.webp@@technology_ayyubids/culture-wing-logistics-1.webp@ (dervish wing)

Take 4 @resource/resource_food.webp@ @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.png@ + 1@unit_worker/villager-abbasid.png@ from@building_economy/town-center.png@ & send to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@. Gather 150 @resource/resource_wood.png@ then go gather 50 @resource/resource_stone.png@ (no mining camp)
Keep @resource/rally.png@@building_economy/town-center.png@ on @resource/resource_food.png@
1 @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@@resource/resource_gold.png@ build @building_defensive/outpost.png@ (upgrade when 50 @resource/resource_stone.png@)
@building_economy/house.webp@
5 @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@@resource/resource_stone.png@ go to @resource/resource_food.png@
<--- Remacro and @resource/rally.webp@to @resource/resource_food.webp@ until age 3
Drop off res and go @age/age_3.webp@ @technology_ayyubids/economic-wing-industry-1.webp@
<--- Remacro. @building_economy/town-center.webp@@resource/rally.webp@ new @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@ until 12
@technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@
Construct 2-3 @building_military/stable.webp@ & 3 @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ & @building_religious/mosque.webp@
@technology_economy/horticulture.webp@ (when possible)

@building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ (get @technology_military/iron-undermesh.webp@@technology_military/wedge-rivets.webp@->@technology_military/steeled-arrow.webp@@technology_military/balanced-projectiles.webp@ -> (sultans mamluks)

description: Feudal Dervish Wing into Stables for Desert Raiders, FC Eco Wing into Camel Lancers, 5 Relics + harrassment
name: Beasty Ayyubids FC
author: ferg40

notes: 6 @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ @building_economy/mill.webp@ on close @resource/deer.webp@. If not close then @resource/berrybush.webp@. 2-2-2 split on berries to keep them alive for Eco wing.
7th @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@@landmark_abbasid/house-of-wisdom.webp@ to connect @building_economy/town-center.webp@ + @building_economy/mill.webp@

1st @resource/resource_gold.webp@ @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ @building_economy/house.webp@ + @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ to connect with @building_economy/town-center.webp@. Rally 4 @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@
Rally to @resource/sheep.webp@ until @age/age_2.webp@

@landmark_abbasid/culture-wing.webp@@technology_ayyubids/culture-wing-logistics-1.webp@. If against @civilization_flag/del.webp@ go @landmark_abbasid/economic-wing.webp@@technology_ayyubids/economic-wing-growth-1.webp@
Pull 2 @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ from @resource/sheep.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@. Rally to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@
Build @building_economy/house.webp@ + @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@ with @resource/resource_wood.webp@ @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@
Age @age/age_2.webp@ complete.

Build @building_military/archery-range.webp@ with 2 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@, and push @building_economy/house.webp@ for @age/goldenagetier1.webp@. When 9 @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ rally to @resource/resource_food.webp@
Make 2-4 @unit_ayyubids/desert-raider-2.webp@ to harass with 2 @unit_ayyubids/dervish-3.webp@. Put any pressure on enemy eco.
@age/goldenagetier1.webp@pull @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.webp@
Rally @resource/resource_food.webp@

@landmark_abbasid/economic-wing.webp@@technology_ayyubids/economic-wing-growth-1.webp@. If against cav civs go @landmark_abbasid/military-wing.webp@@technology_ayyubids/military-wing-reinforcement-1.webp@
Remacro @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@/@resource/resource_gold.webp@ for Castle Age production/tempo push. Rally @resource/resource_food.webp@
Make 2 @building_military/stable.webp@ and 1 @building_religious/mosque.webp@
Age @age/age_3.webp@ complete. Get @resource/relics.webp@ with @unit_ayyubids/dervish-3.webp@

Get @technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@ and eco tech. Get mil tech to counter enemy. Make @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ @unit_ayyubids/camel-lancer-3.webp@ to counter most civs or @unit_ayyubids/desert-raider-2.webp@@unit_ayyubids/camel-lancer-3.webp@ to counter cav civs.

@abilities/attack-move.webp@Fight and choke enemy off map. Keep @resource/resource_food.webp@/@resource/resource_wood.webp@ @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ even. Keep 12 @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@
If you can't close the game make 2TC while harassing.

name: Ayyubids desert raider opening into FC
author: Venlow

notes: all 6 @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ to @resource/berrybush.png@ (2 @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.png@ build @building_economy/mill.png@)
@unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ do @building_economy/house.png@ and go to @resource/berrybush.png@
next 3 @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ go to @resource/resource_gold.png@
next @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ do @landmark_abbasid/house-of-wisdom.png@ and then go to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@
@age/age_2.webp@ with @technology_ayyubids/military-wing-reinforcement-1.png@ REINFORCEMENT

Go to a total of 5 @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ to the @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@   (when @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@ done -> @building_economy/house.png@ and @building_economy/lumber-camp.png@ )
2 more @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.png@/////@building_defensive/outpost.png@ on @resource/resource_gold.png@ If needed,
Next @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.png@ until 15
pressure with @unit_ayyubids/desert-raider-2.webp@    (@building_defensive/palisade-wall.png@ if needed and ez)

with all 5 @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ of @resource/resource_wood.png@ Do one trip to @resource/resource_stone.png@ to @technology_defensive/arrow-slits.png@ on @building_defensive/outpost.png@
3 new @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.png@

@age/age_3.webp@ with @technology_ayyubids/culture-wing-logistics-1.png@ LOGISTIC,  @technology_economy/wheelbarrow.png@ and @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.png@, also drop @building_military/stable.png@@building_military/stable.png@
ALL next @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.png@
@building_religious/mosque.webp@ and get @resource/relics.png@, pressure with @unit_ayyubids/camel-lancer-3.png@

Drop a @building_economy/market.webp@ to trade excess @resource/resource_gold.png@ if needed and @building_technology/blacksmith.png@ --------> @technology_military/iron-undermesh.png@@technology_military/bloomery.png@

Do @building_military/archery-range.webp@@building_military/archery-range.png@@building_military/archery-range.png@ To go full pressure with @unit_ayyubids/camel-lancer-3.png@ And @unit_infantry/archer-2.png@ (@technology_military/steeled-arrow.png@)

description: New Ayyubid meta (never go villager wing)
name: Ayyubids MOST BROKEN Meta Conqueror VortiX
author: Axl

notes: 4 @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ to @resource/berrybush.webp@ 2 build a @building_economy/mill.webp@
1st @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ builds @building_economy/house.webp@ next to @building_economy/mill.webp@ then to @resource/berrybush.webp@
@resource/rally.webp@ @resource/resource_gold.webp@ until 3 (1st@unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ builds @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ )
Next 2 @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ build @landmark_abbasid/house-of-wisdom.webp@ then to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ after tree is finished @resource/resource_wood.webp@
@age/age_2.webp@ with @technology_ayyubids/culture-wing-logistics-1.webp@ (1 more @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ @resource/resource_wood.webp@ then @resource/resource_gold.webp@)

@age/age_3.webp@ MOST OF THE TIME @technology_ayyubids/economic-wing-industry-1.webp@ UNLESS he goes cavalry @technology_ayyubids/military-wing-reinforcement-1.webp@
Going @age/age_3.webp@ get new @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@on @resource/resource_gold.webp@to have 6 then macro to 8 @resource/resource_food.webp@ 10 @resource/resource_wood.webp@

@resource/rally.webp@@resource/resource_wood.webp@ If enemy kicks you out of @resource/resource_gold.webp@just go @resource/resource_wood.webp@, build @building_economy/market.webp@when 100 @resource/resource_wood.webp@and sell@resource/resource_stone.webp@
Army comp based on opponent, usually build @building_military/stable.webp@and @building_military/archery-range.webp@ like crazy
If we are still on gold make a second @building_economy/town-center.webp@, dont sell if no pressure
Can sell @resource/resource_wood.webp@also if we are under pressure, should build great army and remacro GLHF!

description: 2 TC ayyubid build, beasty was bored so he cooked this BO
name: 2 TC ayyubid "the beasty build"
author: Patatasfritas

notes: 1 @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@builds@landmark_abbasid/house-of-wisdom.png@and@building_economy/house.png@, 2@unit_worker/villager-abbasid.png@go to@resource/sheep.png@and 3@unit_worker/villager-abbasid.png@go to@resource/resource_gold.png@(don't make a@building_economy/mining-camp.png@, we need only 30@resource/resource_gold.png@) @resource/rally.png@@resource/resource_food.png@

When you have resources go for@technology_ayyubids/culture-wing-advancement-1.webp@, 6@unit_worker/villager-abbasid.png@go to mine@resource/resource_stone.png@ @resource/rally.png@@resource/resource_stone.png@

Once you have 350@resource/resource_stone.webp@all@unit_worker/villager-abbasid.png@you had in@resource/resource_stone.png@go to@resource/resource_wood.png@ @resource/rally.png@@resource/resource_wood.png@

Once you have 350s and 400w build a@building_economy/town-center.webp@near@resource/resource_wood.png@or@resource/resource_gold.png@ (move 4@unit_worker/villager-abbasid.png@to@resource/resource_food.png@while building it for@unit_worker/villager-abbasid.png@production)

Here you need to build military poroduction buildings, you need to respond to the rival. But most likely you go 2@building_military/archery-range.webp@and 2@building_military/stable.png@then @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.png@and@unit_infantry/archer-2.png@ (Make barracks if it's against knight civ)
Age up with@technology_ayyubids/economic-wing-growth-1.webp@ (If you can don't use@resource/berrybush.png@until age up is done)

description: Fast Castle Build Order popularized by Farm Man Official
name: 1TC Fast Castle with Outpost
author: DataSavant

notes: Send starting vils to berries. Use 2 to build mill, gather with 3. Split vils between berry bushes.
Send first vil to build house then berries, ensure vils are split between bushes, and Rally to gold.
